questions.q: The Next Actions widget sorts open opportunities by next-step date. Where do deals with no date at all appear?
o: At the top, with the overdue ones
questions.e: Overdue and undated deals float to the top. The widget is deliberately sort-based rather than date-filtered so it never goes stale.

questions.q: Which of these can you NOT do through the API on our version of the CRM?
o: Build a dashboard, star a favourite or reorder the sidebar
questions.e: Dashboards are read-only through the API on our version, and favourites and sidebar order cannot be set that way either. They have to be built by hand in the browser.

questions.q: A case has no Received at value. What does that mean for the SLA numbers?
o: It is excluded from the case queue entirely
questions.e: Without a start time there is no clock, so the case is counted as unmeasurable rather than as a pass or a fail. It still appears in the queue and still needs working.

questions.q: Which forecast category means 'keep tracking it, but leave it out of the numbers'?
questions.e: Omitted. Commit is essentially won, Best Case is winnable this period if things go our way, and Pipeline is real but earlier.
